{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify and drop QA orders (revenue == '999999.99') and refunded orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']

# Drop both
filtered_df = df.drop(qa_orders.index.union(refunded_orders.index))

# Compute conversion rate per channel
conversion_rate = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Print the results
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}')
print(f'Rows after filtering: {len(filtered_df)}')
print(f'Conversion rate (email): {conversion_rate["email"]}')
print(f'Conversion rate (paid_search): {conversion_rate["paid_search"]}')"}
